# Shishir Kumar Talukder

> Portfolio and research hub of Shishir Kumar Talukder, a research microbiologist working on antimicrobial resistance, bacterial pathogenesis, and microbial ecology.

## Pages

- [About](/about): Background, research philosophy, education, and skills.
- [Research](/research): Active and past research projects.
- [Publications](/publications): Peer-reviewed papers and preprints.
- [Collaborations](/collaborations): Institutional and academic collaborations.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on microbiology, AMR, and lab techniques.
- [Contact](/contact): Request collaboration or get in touch.
